summary.text: Ayanna Davis is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 65 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Lydia A. Gutiérrez.
She served on the Compton Unified School District board from 2022 to 2026.

paragraphs.text: Davis grew up in a single-parent home in Compton, California, according to her campaign website.
The site says she worked as a classroom teacher and union member and as a public school principal in the Los Angeles Unified School District.

Davis took office as the Area B member of the Compton Unified School District board on July 9, 2022, after the 2022 general election for the seat was canceled and she won without appearing on the ballot.
She left the board on July 21, 2026, and did not run for re-election to it.
She placed first among six candidates in the June 2, 2026 Assembly primary with 46.3 percent of the vote.
Her campaign website says she is running to build more inclusive and just neighborhoods.
